label: Protein Design
description: Computational and experimental protein design, including sequence/structure design, binder and enzyme design, generative models, design validation, and reusable design workflows.

direct.description: The paper directly develops or validates a protein-design method, model, workflow, or designed protein.

contextual.description: The paper studies structure prediction or protein engineering that directly supports design but is not itself primarily a design study.

transferable.description: Target-agnostic algorithms, benchmarks, or experimental screens that are clearly reusable for protein design.

topics.label: 结构建模方法
topics.description: Structure prediction/refinement methods transferable to design workflows.

topics.label: 高通量验证
topics.description: Screening or multiplexed validation useful for designed proteins.

exclusions.description: Do not classify ordinary protein-structure papers as direct design unless a design objective or designed sequence is present.

topics.label: 序列设计
topics.description: Sequence generation, inverse folding, or sequence optimization.

topics.label: 结合蛋白设计
topics.description: Binder, antibody, peptide, or interaction-interface design.

positive_descriptions: Design proteins or sequences with computational/generative methods and experimentally validate the designed products.
negative_descriptions: Protein structure or function studies with no protein-design objective.
transferable_descriptions: Reusable structure modeling or high-throughput validation methods for protein design.
